disease_terms: sepsis OR septic OR endotoxemia OR endotoxaemia OR lipopolysaccharide OR LPS
cardiac_terms: heart OR cardiac OR cardiomyocyte OR myocardial OR cardiotoxicity OR cardiovascular
scope: Targeted evidence review, not exhaustive systematic review; original drug statistics unchanged
independence_rule: Different accession alone is insufficient: check patient/donor origin, study publication, sample IDs and reused resources
mechanism_rule: Select any new mechanism from independent literature before looking at new gene-level concordance; retain negative/toxicity findings; no target mRNA change interpreted as kinase activity
followup_rule: No drug advances to a protective mechanism claim without independent disease support, relevant drug context and reconciled safety/direction evidence
